title: I built a casino resort with a full arcade downstairs. Multiplayer just launched and I want your feedback
author: TheUniverseOrNothing
selftext:
I’ve spent the last few months building a casino resort game. Upstairs you’ve got slots and table games. Downstairs is the arcade: pinball, bowling, shooting games, and more.

Multiplayer just went live, and a lot of updates are still in progress. It’s about 50% finished, so expect rough edges. I’ve put a lot of care into the details, and I’m building toward an official release.

Play here: [play.sunspire.com](http://play.sunspire.com/)

Any feedback helps. The multiplayer/   
Sign ups need the most work and I’m improving this right now.
